description: The Folders window is Epicenter's launcher (ADR-0537). It lists the data folders under the Epicenter folder root by name and title, and opens none itself: choosing one opens that folder's own editor window (open_folder_editor). It opens Todos, Capture, Honeycrisp, or Whispering, which Epicenter bundles, on the app's default folder or a listed one (open_bundled_app), or on a folder the person chooses in the native picker, which Rust opens and answers (choose_folder_for_app), and opens Settings. The shell binds no folder to this window, so it holds no folder command. It listens for the shell's epicenter://data-folders-changed, sent when the list of data folders may have changed. Its page is served on the epicenter-app scheme, so the capability is local (ADR-0561). It shows incoming folder-opening requests; accepting or reopening a remembered path opens a separate editor, while the launcher stays unbound.
